Task: Locate the anchor function for the typed_array_payload field in the console.log object whose action is transcode.buffer.commit, observed after priming a transcode session, selecting the hevc codec profile, the deferred render mode, a frame budget, an operator tag, then packing frames and clicking the final commit button on the page. The anchor function is the first target-specific typed-array transformation value constructor on the dynamic behavior chain: after staged prime/pack/commit gating, transcode envelope routing, clip filtering, tuple preparation and transit/shadow context assembly, its own function body constructs the target observable typed-array payload value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, wrapping a return value, or emitting to the console. Return exactly one complete function as a single JSON object (see answer_format). Do not return generic utilities, event handlers, the full call chain, a factory wrapper, a staged session controller, an envelope router, a clip filter, a formatter or the final sink. Note: you may only inspect code under captures;

Example value pattern: ^ta_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24}$
